text: In Nazi Germany, Hitler ordered Munro Leaf's The Story of Ferdinand burned as “degenerate democratic propaganda.” After the war, Jewish journalist Jella Lepman, founder of the International Youth Library, worked with the US Army to distribute 30,000 copies to German children. The book was also banned in Franco’s Spain.
